question: In which of the following years was the census not conducted in Jammu & Kashmir?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1991**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Census of India** is a massive decennial exercise conducted every **10 years** to gather demographic, social, and economic data.
 
• In the year **1991**, the census was conducted throughout the country, but it was **not conducted** in the state of **Jammu & Kashmir**. ***Hence, the correct answer is 1991.***
 
• The enumeration was skipped in **Jammu & Kashmir** during **1991** primarily due to intense **militancy** and **civil unrest** that prevailed in the region at that time, which hindered the safety and movement of census officials.
 
• This was not the first time a state was excluded; in **1981**, the census was not conducted in **Assam** due to the **Assam Agitation** and widespread political instability in that state.
